insights.text: Malaysia Women win 72% of our simulations.
Powerplay: Malaysia Women ~27 runs for 1.3 wickets; no wicket at all in 28% of simulations.
Malaysia Women's first wicket most likely falls around over 4; Zhao Yihan is the likeliest to take it (18%).
Ainna Hamizah Hashim is Malaysia Women's likeliest top scorer (29%), with a 26% chance of 30+.
Powerplay: China Women ~26 runs for 2.0 wickets; no wicket at all in 11% of simulations.
China Women's first wicket most likely falls around over 3; Nur Dania Syuhada is the likeliest to take it (20%).
Hong Yali is China Women's likeliest top scorer (21%), with a 10% chance of 30+.
Nurin Imanina leads Malaysia Women's attack: 35% chance of 2+ wickets.
Zhao Yihan leads China Women's attack: 27% chance of 2+ wickets.
